Name: Turn-Based Combat
Author: GoodSmarts
Description:
[center][b][size=6][youtube]VQ2zIydNNXI[/youtube][/size][/b][/center]
[center][size=1](Modded location from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]. Not a requirement.)[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][size=6]--- Features ---[/size][/b][/center]
[left][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod adds a turn-based combat system, which triggers whenever you make direct contact with an enemy. You can still use weapons out of combat and fight like vanilla, but instead of getting hit, you're taken to a battle screen.

I designed sound effects for entering battle, winning a battle, and made battle music for during the fights. Volumes of all three are configurable with GMCM.[/color][/size]

In battle, you have four options:
[list=1]
[*]Attack - Use your currently equipped weapon and attack the enemy.[/*]
[*]Dodge - Cause enemy attacks to have an 80% chance to miss for two turns.[/*]
[*]Item - Equip a new weapon or consume an item from your inventory.[/*]
[*]Flee - Attempt to escape the battle, with a 49% success rate.[/*]
[/list]Your initial equipped weapon for the battle is whatever you had selected in your hotbar when the battle began. If it wasn't a weapon, you will attack with your fists. To equip a new weapon, choose "Item" and select one. The enemy gets a turn after you equip or use an item.

If GMCM is installed, there's also an options button on the bottom right of the battle menu. From there, you can disable the mod entirely, adjust sound effect/music volume, or adjust the delay between actions during battle.[/left]
[left][/left]
[left][size=2]One little note: Enemies that are meant to be invulnerable (like Mummies, those hard Bugs) can be killed if you defeat them in turn-based combat.[/size][/left]
[center][/center]
[center][b][size=6]--- Requirements ---[/size][/b][/center]
[center][left]The only requirement is SMAPI.[/left]
[left]However, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] is highly recommended.[/left]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][size=6]--- Compatibility ---[/size][/b][/center]
[left][b][color=#ff0000][size=4]MULTIPLAYER NOT TESTED.[/size][/color][/b][/left]
[center][left][b][color=#ff0000][size=4]MOBILE NOT TESTED - 99.9% CHANCE IT WON'T WORK.[/size][/color][/b][/left]
[left]Compatible with modded enemies and weapons.[/left]
[left]Compatible with Fashion Sense outfits.[/left]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=6][b]--- My Thoughts ---[/b][/size][/center]
[center][left]Is it balanced? Probably not. Does it look particularly good? Not really. Does it make early-game harder? Maybe, but you can still fight outside of the battle menu still so I'm not really sure. Does it fit with Stardew Valley's regular gameplay? No lol. Does it make any sense not to always pick dodge before doing anything? No, but I wanted more variety than just attacking, using items, and running. Should it be a staple in Stardew Nexus Collections, or anyone's regular modlist? Probably not. Are the battles extremely short with a good weapon, forcing you to listen to first 3 seconds of the battle theme over and over again? Yes, but that's a staple of old-school JRPGs, and at least you can turn the music off.

It's really more for the novelty. Stardew's art style is very similar to old-school 16-bit graphics and JRPGs of that era, so I thought it might be neat if it had that battle system too.[/left]

[b][size=6]--- AI Disclaimer ---[/size][/b]
[left]Very sorry to disappoint, but this mod [b]was vibe-coded[/b] with Claude; I'll admit to it. If anything, let this mod put the idea into the head of an actual modder that knows what they're doing and could make something better. [b]The music and sound effects are NOT made with AI. [/b]Absolutely [b]no AI[/b] was used making them.[b] [/b]I made them myself in FL Studio the morning of writing this. Self-admittedly, I'm not a developer, but I am a musician.[/left]
[/center]
